sources.title: QuarkXPress - Choose how you buy (perpetual vs. subscription, via search snippet)

keyLimits.en: USD 279/year, includes upgrades, updates and technical support while active, with automatic renewal.
USD 699 one-time purchase; no upgrades or support included after purchase unless a separate Advantage maintenance plan is added.

addOns.en: QuarkXPress Advantage Plan: optional maintenance/support add-on for perpetual license holders.

cautions.en: The perpetual license does not include ongoing upgrades or support by default; customers must add a separate Advantage maintenance plan to keep receiving updates.

capabilities.en: Professional desktop publishing (DTP) for brochures, magazines, books and multi-channel documents with advanced typography and style-sheet management.
Collaborative workflows for teams working on layout projects.

limitations.en: No free tier or ongoing free version; access requires either a paid subscription or a one-time perpetual license purchase.
Perpetual license buyers lose access to new feature updates unless they separately purchase an Advantage maintenance plan.

reason.en: Adobe's dominant desktop publishing tool and QuarkXPress's main direct competitor in professional layout work.
Lower-cost desktop publishing alternative with a one-time purchase model, appealing to the same budget-conscious segment as QuarkXPress's perpetual license.

unknowns: The main product page (quark.com/products/quarkxpress) returned empty content to automated fetch in this session; pricing and buying-options details rely on search-engine snippets of official Quark pages instead of a direct read.
Exact contents of the Advantage maintenance plan (price, duration) were not verified.
